### The five pillars of the agentic organization

Common goal-setting pitfalls and solutions
Goals feel mandated and disconnected: Focus goal setting on how employees’ work connects with their individual purpose and with the organizational strategy.
Goals are siloed: Collaborate with key stakeholders to identify interdependencies and align on goals.
Goals become outdated and forgotten: Conduct check-ins to ensure that employees’ goals support their ongoing performance, development, and engagement.
Goals prioritize quick wins over long-term success: Differentiate between short-term task-driven performance goals and long-term outcome-driven learning goals.

Tap each card to learn more

![](https://media.ceros.com/mckinsey/images/2025/11/03/e9b4f5a13ad73150e396503e2de271ce/processed-svg-hand.svg)

Technology and data

![](https://media.ceros.com/mckinsey/images/2025/10/30/eb7bbb7a809498a21d200fe70b4d4028/tech-data-icon.svg)

Technology will be democratized, powered by agent-to-agent protocols, and built around systems that are faster and more flexible than traditional platforms.

Technology and data

Workforce, people, and culture

![](https://media.ceros.com/mckinsey/images/2025/10/30/a9926d7d0cdc3dea6917b7ac87f527f0/workforce-icon.svg)

Talent systems will need to evolve, with humans moving from executing activities to defining goals and steering outcomes.

Workforce, people, and culture

Governance

![](https://media.ceros.com/mckinsey/images/2025/10/30/1938fd17a98797ea08f7594aba4813e3/governance-icon.svg)

Governance must happen in real time, be data driven, and be fully embedded in the organization, with humans holding final accountability.

Governance

Operating model

![](https://media.ceros.com/mckinsey/images/2025/10/30/972f3ad5ec9e67a6c7906b7d5f476f50/operating-model-icon.svg)

Operating models will need to be anchored around reimagined, AI-first work and workflows and networks of small, outcome-focused agentic teams.

Operating model

Business model

![](https://media.ceros.com/mckinsey/images/2025/10/30/2ddab5923d9290e1036a7ed1f47580ab/business-model-icon.svg)

The business model of the agentic era will enable real-time personalization, reinvent processes to be AI-first, and continually secure proprietary data.

Business model
